name: Eco World Development Group Berhad
summary: Eco World Development Group Berhad, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the property development business in Malaysia, the United Kingdom, and Australia. It operates through three segments: Residential, Commercial, and Industrial. The company offers landed homes, high-rise residential apartments, offices and retail spaces, and green industrial parks. It is also involved in property investment holding; property and project management; construction; provision of digital solutions; traders or business of building materials; marketing; and consultancy services.
